input: My cotton crop in Satara was destroyed by sudden hailstorm yesterday. I have PMFBY insurance through my Kisan Credit Card.

A factory workman injured on site without compensation, cannot afford court fee. Needs free legal aid panel advocate under Legal Services Authorities Act.
